notes: Single style on the page. Decoded year/month values are derived from the page's stated positions, not page-stated: the page gives no decoded date for its example.

styles.notes: Counting-convention judgment (flagged): the page says year from the '2nd & 3rd numerical digits' and month from the '4th and 5th numerical digits'. Digit-only counting gives year 11 but month 00, which is invalid, so that reading is falsified by the page's own example. Character-position counting (1-based positions in the full serial) gives year 11 and month 10, i.e. October 2011, so the file uses character positions. The leading letter is attested only as M; the pattern accepts any capital letter in that position.
